svg.aria-label: When should an AI not start writing? It fails: A single prompt writes a confident email even when the request is vague or missing facts. It catches: Ordinary code checks the request first, then a model judges whether there is enough to write from. Limit: For one unclear request it still wrote an email when it should have asked.
